page.layout: Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Two engraved medallions side by side, left with the legend around Charles V, right with the legend around Isabella. Below them one column of running text, full width, with paragraphs. Signature at bottom right. No marginal notes, no footnotes, no catchword.

main_text.p: CAROLVS quintus, Philippi Austriæ Archiducis filius, post auum Maximilianum imperat anno mundi 5481. à Christo nato 1519. postea Bononiæ à Clemente Pontifice imperiali diademate coronatus est anno D. 1529. porrò anno sequente ingentem exercitum per Germaniam in Hügariā duxit aduersus Turcam Viennā obsidentē. Inde victoriam reportans in Hispaniam rediit. Anno autem 1535. in Tunetim expeditionē parans, quæ olim Carthago erat, eam Solimano Turcæ extorquet: Gouletā arcē expugnat: regnūque Tunitiū totū recipit, &c Regē Altzachenū antè pulsū restituit, multis Christianis captiuis liberatis. Frācia bis tētauit, sed Frāci milites validissimis armis eius impetū forti animo sustinuere. Semel in Francia tanquā amicus summo apparatu exceptus est, ex Hispania in Flādriā per Galliā iter sibi fecit. At enim an. 1543. cū potentissimo exercitu Germaniā tandē ingressus, eam ferè totā in suā vertit sententiā, captis etiā aliquot Germanorū Ducibus ac primoribus: à quibus atq; ab vrbibus Germaniæ olim liberis, ingētē auri vim corrasit. Anno verò 1551. in Africā Libyę ciuitatē exercitū traiecit, principe Doria præfecto, quam feliciter expugnauit, solutis nō paucis captiuis Christianis. An. 1552. Confœderatis aliquot Germanorum Principibus cū Henrico Christianiss. Francorū Rege, ea gratia vt eos ab Imperatoris iugo excuteret, pedem in Villacū Carolus quasi coactus reculit: sed intra paucos dies re cū aliquot Germanis primoribus cōposita, cōparato maximo Germanorū exercitu, ipse Mediomatricū, vrbē prius ab Hērico Rege captam, ac Francicis armis munitam obsedit: vbi nouercam fortunam expertus, obsidionem soluere cogitur, cum non modica suorum strage ac damno, partim ob temporis inclementiam, partim ob Francorum robur ac vigilantiam.
ISABELLA Portugalliæ Regis filia, Caroli prędicti vxor peperit ei liberos quatuor, atque in partu vltimo emoritur.

page.notes: Two engraved medallion legends are printed above the text; their letters are worn, so the legend on the right ("CAR. V") is uncertain and the left legend's exact letters may be incomplete. Reference "reculit" in the line "Villacū Carolus quasi coactus reculit" is doubtful. Printed spacing and run-ons such as "Hispaniain" and "Germaniā" are kept as the scan shows them. Printing errors kept as printed, e.g. "Tunetim", "Hispania in", "Tunitiū".
